purpose: Spawnpoint-only authored asset vocabulary. These are data descriptions of buildable little chunks, not runtime objects.

families.label: Televisions
rules: Exactly one primary screen focus.
Screen must be legible from at least two seating candidates.
No luxury/home-theater hardware.
Variant placement metadata is authoritative: wall-mount panels do not consume a support surface.

variants.label: Woodgrain motel CRT
variants.notes: Heavy, slightly too deep for its table.

families.label: TV support / refuge shared surfaces

sockets.topSurface: support plane for TV and small clutter

rules: When the selected TV consumes a surface, the support must be believable for its mass.
When the selected TV is wall-mounted, this object remains as the refuge shared surface.
At least one edge remains usable for a bottle/cup or remote-sized object.

families.label: Rooftop seating
rules: Primary seats bias toward TV but never form a showroom-perfect arc.
At least two seating opportunities; maximum four obvious seats.
Matching pairs are allowed only when another seat deliberately breaks the set.

families.label: Drinks, ash, snacks, and small evidence
rules: Labels remain generic unless another content system deliberately supplies text.
At least one recent-human-trace object appears in identity/life phases.

families.label: Practical rooftop lights
rules: At least one warm practical exists even when the TV is the dominant cool source.
Avoid evenly illuminating the whole roof.

families.label: Power and cable dressing
rules: Cables should explain how the impossible little refuge is powered.
Cable paths never cross reserved circulation without being taped, elevated, or perimeter-biased.

families.label: Rooftop utility hardware
rules: Utilities frame the refuge but never become random obstacle soup.
At least one medium mechanical silhouette should sell that this is a real roof.

families.label: Nearby vacuum-tube monuments
rules: Treat as a fictionalized electronics monument, not a claim that an exact historical tube was building-sized.
Glass envelope, base, internal electrode silhouettes, and filament glow should remain readable.
The tube is nearby skyline, not inside the lounge cluster.

families.label: Small rooftop plant life
rules: Plants are optional and imperfect; never turn the refuge into a curated rooftop garden.

globalStyle.condition: used, maintained just enough, occasionally repaired
forbidden: random cyberpunk greeble with no use
